scope.summary: Prove parallel swarm body authoring per Section 13.25 (HBR-SWARM parity with the garment lane, SREQ-020): N concurrent agent sessions author and edit bodies through the MCP tools with scheduler leases, per-op attribution, and clean cancellation, demonstrating the CRDT + sandbox + job stack under real concurrency.
acceptance_criteria: At least 4 concurrent sessions author distinct bodies end-to-end (author_body -> edit_body -> validate) with per-session leases; no session observes another's draft state without an explicit ref.
Two sessions editing DIFFERENT channels of the SAME shared draft both land via CRDT merge; two sessions editing the SAME channel resolve LWW with both ops retained in the ledger (attribution intact).
Every op carries session attribution on its EventLedger event; the ledger reconstructs who changed what.
Cancelling one session mid-work cancels only its jobs and leases; other sessions complete unaffected.
The run is recorded as HBR-SWARM evidence for the BodyKit surface (MT-652 consumes it).
scope.risk_if_missed: The swarm claim stays theoretical: first real parallel use corrupts drafts or deadlocks leases in production, and BodyKit fails the same HBR-SWARM bar the garment lane already passed.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
